problem_text:
A hospital needs to schedule 7 patients for 7 different medical tests.

Each patient must follow a specific sequence of tests, represented as pairs (Test, Duration),
where each pair specifies the test to be performed and the time required to complete it.
The order of the pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the tests must be conducted.

Patient details:
* P1 requires the sequence: (T5, 8) → (T7, 7) → (T3, 1) → (T2, 8) → (T4, 1) → (T1, 9) → (T6, 7)
* P2 requires the sequence: (T7, 8) → (T4, 3) → (T2, 4) → (T6, 8) → (T1, 5) → (T5, 6) → (T3, 8)
* P3 requires the sequence: (T5, 1) → (T2, 3) → (T7, 6) → (T1, 1) → (T4, 6) → (T6, 10) → (T3, 3)
* P4 requires the sequence: (T7, 3) → (T4, 7) → (T6, 1) → (T2, 6) → (T5, 9) → (T3, 4) → (T1, 6)
* P5 requires the sequence: (T2, 10) → (T5, 8) → (T6, 1) → (T4, 4) → (T1, 8) → (T7, 10) → (T3, 6)
* P6 requires the sequence: (T5, 4) → (T6, 8) → (T2, 10) → (T1, 4) → (T4, 2) → (T3, 9) → (T7, 7)
* P7 requires the sequence: (T6, 6) → (T7, 9) → (T3, 6) → (T5, 8) → (T2, 7) → (T1, 8) → (T4, 6)

Each test must be conducted without interruption once it begins, and each testing facility can only handle one patient at a time.
The objective is to determine the scheduling order of all patient tests across the facilities so that the total completion time for all patients is minimized.
